title: Mau Mau uprising in Kenya
summary: The Mau Mau uprising was an armed revolt against British colonial rule in Kenya, mainly by Kikuyu fighters, over land and inequality. After the killing of Senior Chief Waruhiu in October 1952 the government declared a state of emergency. Guerrillas fought from Mount Kenya and the Aberdares, and by 1956 the revolt was largely crushed.

uncertainty.note: SAHO says the uprising began in 1952 and had effectively been crushed by 1956; Encyclopedia.com says guerrillas operated from October 1952 to 1956. The state of emergency itself lasted longer but its end date was not confirmed on an opened page.
